data.assumption: “Phones sold” means the sum of item quantities for non-accessory products on completed, non-test UK showroom orders during last month, grouped by storage size.
data.sql:
SELECT p.storage_gb, SUM(oi.qty) AS value
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.sku = oi.sku
WHERE o.is_test = FALSE
  AND c.name = 'United Kingdom'
  AND o.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND o.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND p.is_accessory = FALSE
GROUP BY p.storage_gb
ORDER BY p.storage_gb
